verdict.rationale: Working Copy's AI features (commit-message suggestions, Code Agent) are described as opt-in and "respect your data." The manual says AI suggestions send staged diffs to OpenAI, so declining them keeps code away from the AI provider. However, nothing in the evidence addresses whether data that is sent can be used for model training. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or training opt-out, documentation of OpenAI data-retention and training terms, and independent corroboration.
